high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the website "Mint." The headline reads: "Earthquake today: 3.6 magnitude quake hits Madhya Pradesh's Seoni | Mint." The article was posted 3 hours ago. The main visual element in the image is a close-up photograph of a seismograph chart. The chart displays blue lines that represent seismic activity, with peaks indicating the intensity of the earthquake. A hand is pointing to one of these peaks, drawing attention to it. The background of the chart is white with grid lines, which help in measuring the amplitude and frequency of the seismic waves.
